_about: gamma-Valerolactone (1) + Water (2): isothermal total pressures at 350.2 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of gamma-valerolactone, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.
